title: First-Year Programming Graduate Assistant
bio: Roxanne will work with the incredible Residential Life team to plan and implement meaningful opportunities that support first- year students in building community and engaging in student life. She is passionate about creating spaces for students to flourish and thrive in higher education settings where they can feel empowered to be proud of their identities. Roxanne was a community college alumna who transferred to UC Berkeley and graduated with a Bachelor's degree in media studies and a minor in Asian American and Asian Diaspora studies. She was heavily involved in student organizing for recruitment and retention centers on campus. Prior to her time at Harvard, she worked for the UC Berkeley Destination College Advising Corps and Early Academic Outreach Program as a college adviser in the Bay Area. In her spare time, she enjoys trying new coffee and dessert shops and exploring with her loved ones. Area Residential Life First-Year Experience Programming Staff Role Graduate Assistants
